name: Christian Guard
description: Christian Guard is a Christian Identity organization based in Lakeland, Florida. It operated as a member group of the Blood & Honour America Division, an umbrella white-power coalition that also included Volksfront and the Hammerskin Nation. The group held fundraisers at Confederate Hammerskin events and maintained close ties to Volksfront, particularly through Abbie Chelf, a Christian Guard adherent who rose to a leadership role within Volksfront circles.
